name: Explain appointment no show patterns
why: Turns a de-identified booking export into a no-show pattern summary, a first input to the monthly KPI pack.

name: Measure a clinic administrative queue
why: Maps where repeat admin tasks such as records requests or referral letters wait, matching the patient flow and records request work.

name: Document a clinic appointment intake process
why: Writes the intake procedure for desk staff, a companion to the front desk procedures skill.

name: Check a clinic service information page
why: Checks a clinic service page against approved facts, useful when publishing price lists and fee information.

name: Clinic referral handover reviewer
why: Reviews referral handovers so nothing waits unowned, the same discipline as the records request log.

name: Prepare a referral administration handover
why: Hands over open referral admin to the next person with owners and dates, for leave and staff changes.

name: Clinic claims collections bridge
why: Rolls claims receivable forward and matches insurer payments to the bank using totals only, for the receivables line of the KPI pack.

name: Clinic claim cash reconciliation checker
why: Matches claim remittances to cash received without patient details, so the owner sees what money actually arrived.

name: Process doc freshness keeper
why: Finds stale or ownerless procedures each month, keeping front desk procedures current.

name: Complaint reply promise checker
why: Checks a draft complaint reply for promises the practice cannot keep, before the owner signs it.

name: Input metric picker
why: Picks the input measures the desk can control, such as next bookings made at check-out, behind the KPIs the owner watches.
